name: Resplendent Quetzal
description: One of the most iconic birds in Costa Rica. Best seen in cloud forest habitat, especially around wild avocado fruiting trees.

name: Keel-billed Toucan
description: Colorful tropical bird commonly seen in rainforest areas, forest edges, and fruiting trees.

name: Scarlet Macaw
locations: Carara National Park, Osa Peninsula, Tarcoles
description: Large red, yellow, and blue parrot often seen flying in pairs near Pacific lowland forest and mangrove edges.

name: Three-wattled Bellbird
description: A distinctive cloud forest species known for its loud metallic call. Seasonal movements can affect viewing chances.

name: Snowcap
description: Tiny hummingbird with a striking white cap on males. Often sought at flowering shrubs and forest edge feeders.
